WinkBeds · WIN286 · Convert exp 100350738

Persistent Targeted Offer: QA report

Sitewide · all users · Control 1003184955 vs Variation 1003184956 · QA 2026-10-15 · Playwright on Chrome, Safari, Mobile Chrome (Pixel 5), Mobile Safari (iPhone 12). No code was supplied; it was extracted from the live Convert bundle (snapshot 10:39Z).

Not launch-ready

The badge flow follows the wireframe on every browser: dismiss, then badge; reopen; persistence across pages and sessions; hiding when the cart stops qualifying; no badge after accepting; reduced motion. The blockers are goal tracking (nothing usable fires for WIN286), the badge disappearing under the Buy Box on mobile, and three launch settings.

17 / 22Safari Desktop passed · 1 not run
16 / 22Mobile Chrome (Pixel 5) passed · 1 not run
15 / 21Mobile Safari (iPhone 12) passed · 2 not run

Bugs

HighBUG-01 · Goal tracking does not work for WIN286

  • The Variation pushes the modal-fire goal with an empty id: _conv_q.push(["triggerConversion", ""]). No Convert request carried a WIN286 goal id on any browser (TC-17).
  • The Control pushes 100334580, which is WIN276's "modal fires" goal and isn't attached to exp 100350738. So neither arm records "WIN286 - Modal Fires".
  • "Clicks on Modal CTA", "Clicks on Sticky Badge" and "Clicks on Sticky Badge Close Icon (mobile)" have no code trigger and no click goal in the experiment. Only code goal 100334668 is attached, plus revenue, cart visit and Buy Box ATC.

Fix: create the four goals and attach them to 100350738. Push their ids from both arms (modal fire, CTA click) and from the Variation (badge click, badge close).

HighBUG-02 · Mobile shop page: badge is hidden under the Buy Box

The badge has z-index: 99, and on mobile the Buy Box sections paint over it as you scroll through them. elementFromPoint at the badge centre returns .dummySelectFirmness, .order-form__loadup-container, .order-form__freeShipping or li.accessory-tray_item (Pixel 5 at 600–1800px, iPhone 12 at 1800–3000px). That is exactly where the native Frost™ Cooling toggle sits, and the badge can't be seen or tapped there. Desktop is fine.

MediumBUG-03 · Mobile close icon overlaps the badge's reopen area

The 44×44 close hit area (top:-8px; right:-8px on the rotated container) covers 36×36px (1296px²) of the badge itself. Tapping the lower end of the badge hits the close icon, which hides the badge for the session instead of reopening the offer. The wireframe says the close icon must not overlap the badge's reopen action. Seen on Pixel 5 and iPhone 12.

MediumBUG-04 · Badge vanishes for 2.6–4.3s on every page load

The wireframe says to keep the badge in place while scrolling and across pages. The badge is only rendered after the activation deployment's setTimeout(…, 3000), a cart fetch and Convert's executeExperiment, so on every navigation it is missing for several seconds after the page is usable. The measurements table below has the numbers. Suggested fix: for the badge cohort (cre286_modal_dismissed=true), render immediately from the cookie, then check /cart.js and remove the badge if the cart no longer qualifies.

LowBUG-05 · Badge position doesn't match the wireframe

The container is rotated 90° about its centre, so bottom:20% and left:-75px apply to the unrotated box. Measured: the badge's visual bottom sits 8.9–10.5% above the viewport bottom instead of 20%. On desktop it starts at x = −6.8px, so its left edge and padding are clipped; on mobile it's −1.5px. Fix with transform-origin, or compute bottom from the rotated height.

LowBUG-06 · Badge, close icon and CTA don't respond to the keyboard

They have role="button" tabindex="0" but only click handlers, so Enter and Space do nothing (TC-18, Chrome and Safari).

LowBUG-07 · Control adds the body class cre-t-286-variation

The Control code sets variation_name to "cre-t-286-variation". The behaviour is correct (no new line, no badge), but analytics and heatmap segments keyed on that class will mix both arms.

Before launch

LaunchLAUNCH-01 · "New session" threshold is 2 minutes

Deployment 100350740 has ONE_HOUR_MS = 2 * 60 * 1000, and TC-20 confirms Cohort 2 opens after only a 3-minute idle. The live WIN276 deployment already uses 60 minutes. Set it back before launch.

LaunchLAUNCH-02 · Control is stopped (0% traffic)

In the bundle, Control 1003184955 is status: stopped, traffic 0 and the Variation gets 100%. The force URL still works for QA, but if it launches like this there is no A/B comparison. Confirm the split.

LaunchLAUNCH-03 · Pause WIN276 when WIN286 goes to all users

WIN276 (100350628) is live with the audience "campaign does NOT contain Cro286mode", and its deployments 100350629/630 run for everyone. Once WIN286 drops the Cro286mode audience, both experiments qualify the same visitors with separate cookies (cre276_* and cre286_*), so a visitor can get two modals.

LaunchLAUNCH-04 · Cohort 2 still waits an extra 5s (carried over from WIN276)

The Variation adds setTimeout(5000) after the activation's 3s wait, so Cohort 2 opens 9.6–10.5s after load. This is the same behaviour as WIN276 BUG-03, flagged here only because WIN286 inherits the existing modal targeting.

What works

Modal

  • The copy matches the wireframe, and the new line "Not ready? Close this offer. Reopen it from the side of your screen." is centred under the CTA on all browsers.
  • Control shows the unchanged WIN276 modal and no badge.
  • Accepting swaps the cart line to "Twin with Frost Cooling Cover", redirects to checkout with FROST8UYR31, and no badge appears afterwards.

Badge

  • Appears after closing with X or the overlay. The slide-in takes 0.22s, plays the first time only, and is skipped with reduced motion.
  • Clicking it reopens the modal and the badge hides while the modal is open. It returns on re-dismiss, and the modal-fire goal isn't counted again.
  • Persists across pages and into a new session, and the modal never reopens automatically.
  • Hides immediately when the mattress is removed. A Frost variant, two WinkBeds, qty 2 or an empty cart all give no badge.
  • The mobile close hides it for the session and it returns next session. Desktop has no close icon.

How this was tested

The spec is testing/win286-persistent-targeted-offer.spec.js (20 cases, 23 checks per browser) and the bundle extractor is testing/win286-recon/extract.js. Each case seeds a real production cart (Luxury Firm Twin) and the WIN286 cookies in a fresh browser context, then loads the force URL. "Next session" means a new context that keeps only persistent cookies. Goal pushes were captured by wrapping window._conv_q. On iPhone 12 the site's own timed popup (cre-wb-test-28) blocked the cart-drawer check twice, so that case is unverified there.
